subject.title: [Bug]: Enabling Codex plugin causes Runtime to switch to OpenAI Codex and ignore configured primary model, resulting in GPT-5.4-nano TPM failures

question: Should #99449 stay open as the concrete DeepSeek/Codex repro while the fix is coordinated with #87957 and #101672, or should maintainers fold it into one canonical tracker now?
rationale: The source path is plausible but the exact clean trigger is not proven, and the repair boundary crosses persisted session state, OpenAI/Codex runtime defaults, and doctor ownership.

options.title: Keep concrete repro open
options.body: Keep #99449 open as the external reproduction anchor until live proof identifies whether the fix belongs in shared session resolution, stale auto-route cleanup, or doctor ownership.

options.title: Fold into resolver tracker
options.body: Close as a duplicate of #87957 only if maintainers are comfortable losing the separate clean DeepSeek/Codex reproduction thread.

options.title: Queue narrow repair after proof
options.body: Queue a fix PR only after live reproduction proves the exact current-main trigger and the owner boundary is no longer ambiguous.
